name: sync-socials
description: Create social media drafts, import media, manage your posting queue, and schedule or publish to connected accounts in your Sync Socials workspace.

SYNC_SOCIALS_API_KEY.title: Sync Socials workspace API key
SYNC_SOCIALS_API_KEY.description: Use your workspace API key from Sync Socials settings. It grants workspace read/write access; replacing or revoking it can disconnect other clients using that key.
